distinction.active_price_cross_venue: Price/basis arrival order alone cannot trigger; every event requires cross-venue OI state.
distinction.closed_single_venue_oi: The primary state is cross-venue OI breadth/divergence, not Bybit OI plus same-venue flow.
distinction.multi_asset_positioning: No completed 5m cross-sectional basket or account-ratio state; execution is same-symbol Bybit only.

execution_contract.capacity: At most 5% of observed top-quote quantity and capped by 0.5% NAV stop risk and 3x notional leverage.
execution_contract.cost_interpretation: Observed BBO spread is embedded in entry and exit; cost grid is additional round-trip fee/slippage/impact stress.
execution_contract.entry: At decision plus 100ms or 500ms, buy causally current ask or sell causally current bid, with one-second BBO freshness limit.
execution_contract.funding: Actual Bybit historical funding settlements in (entry, exit] with correct side.
execution_contract.global_slot: One pending/open BTC/ETH position; same-timestamp re-entry prohibited.
execution_contract.instrument: Bybit BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT USDT linear perpetual.
execution_contract.stop: Outside the completed Bybit event extreme plus one decision spread and no tighter than two decision spreads; adverse stop rebound.
execution_contract.target: Fixed 1R or 2R barrier; no elapsed-time forced exit.

feature_contract.flow: Venue-specific signed aggressive quote-notional divided by total quote-notional; flow size is normalized by prior-only rolling median notional.
feature_contract.oi_change: Within each venue, relative OI change from the latest update received before window start to the latest update received before the completed decision boundary.
feature_contract.oi_standardization: Within-venue prior-only 1,800-second rolling standard deviation shifted one completed observation.
feature_contract.price_response: Completed Binance and Bybit trade returns expressed in causally known Bybit BBO spread units.
feature_contract.threshold_transition: Each candidate acts only on the first completed window of its own eligibility run.
feature_contract.venue_relation: Common families require balanced absolute OI z-scores; lead/trap families require dominant-venue OI share.

interpretation_boundary.survivor_action: Freeze exact survivors and expand to every remaining pre-2024 first-day sample before any 2024 opening.
interpretation_boundary.zero_survivor_action: Retire this exact cross-venue OI-breadth dependency without adjacent threshold, latency, target, stop, risk, leverage or cost retuning.

mechanisms.binance_oi_lead_continuation: Binance OI and aggressor flow expand before Bybit OI/price fully respond; trade the residual catch-up only when the OI dominance and price gap are both large.
mechanisms.bybit_specific_opening_trap: Bybit OI expands without comparable Binance breadth while high Bybit effort produces weak or unconfirmed price response; fade trapped Bybit opening inventory.
mechanisms.common_closing_cascade: Both venues show negative standardized OI innovations with aligned aggressive flow and efficient displacement; follow the closing cascade.
mechanisms.common_closing_exhaustion: Both venues close leverage together but Bybit shows large range and weak close efficiency; fade the exhausted closure burst.
mechanisms.common_opening_continuation: Both venues show positive standardized OI innovations with balanced magnitude, aligned aggressive flow and efficient common price displacement; follow the common flow.

objective: Test whether cross-venue breadth and divergence of same-symbol open-interest innovations separate common leverage creation/closure from venue-specific trapped leverage strongly enough to overcome Bybit spread, fees, slippage, impact and one-slot opportunity cost.
prohibitions: No parameter, family, cost, risk or leverage change after outcomes.
No liquidation labels, L2 cancel/refill, options, wallet identity, cross-asset follower or OCO information.
No credentials, paper, testnet or live orders.

source_contract.availability_clock: Tardis local_timestamp; all features use completed windows and messages received strictly before the decision boundary.
source_contract.gap_rule: A Bybit decision or order boundary with BBO older than one second is unavailable; accepted positions unresolved at source boundary are valued at the structural stop.
